events.title: PCP visit — initial workup
events.summary: Annual physical with Dr. Levy. Patient reported fatigue for three months and increased thirst (polydipsia), along with intermittent blurred vision and nocturia.

source.snippet: Pt presents today for routine annual physical. Reports fatigue × 3 months and increased thirst.

events.title: HbA1c — 9.2 %
events.summary: Glycated hemoglobin (A1c) is significantly elevated at 9.2%, well above the normal range of 4.0–5.6%. Result is consistent with new-onset Type 2 diabetes.

events.title: Glucose, fasting — 187 mg/dL
events.summary: Fasting blood glucose is elevated at 187 mg/dL, well above the normal range of 70–99 mg/dL, consistent with new-onset diabetes.

events.title: LDL — 132 mg/dL
events.summary: LDL (low-density lipoprotein, or 'bad' cholesterol) is elevated at 132 mg/dL, above the target of under 100 mg/dL.

events.title: Dx added: Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus
events.summary: Type 2 diabetes (a condition of high blood sugar) was added to the active problem list based on today's lab results and symptoms.

source.snippet: Assessment: Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus (E11.9) — added to problem list.

events.title: Started metformin 500 mg b.i.d.
events.summary: Metformin 500 mg by mouth twice daily with meals was started as first-line treatment for newly diagnosed Type 2 diabetes.

source.snippet: Plan: Start metformin 500 mg PO b.i.d. with meals. F/u in 3 months for repeat A1c.

events.title: Referral to diabetes educator
events.summary: Patient was referred to a diabetes educator for education on managing her new Type 2 diabetes diagnosis.

source.snippet: Refer to diabetes educator. Home glucometer prescribed; check fasting BG 3×/week.

events.title: HbA1c — 8.4 %
events.summary: Hemoglobin A1c (a measure of average blood sugar over ~3 months) came back at 8.4%, which is above the normal range of 4.0–5.6% and above the typical diabetes management goal of below 7.0%. This is an improvement from the prior result of 9.2%.

events.title: HbA1c — 8.4%
events.summary: Glycated hemoglobin (A1c) improved from 9.2% to 8.4% after starting metformin, but remains above the treatment goal of less than 7.0%.

source.snippet: April lab work (drawn 04/18/2023) showed A1c improved from 9.2% to 8.4%, which is encouraging but still above the goal of <7.0%.

events.title: PCP follow-up — diabetes management
events.summary: Three-month follow-up for Type 2 Diabetes (T2D) with Dr. Levy. Patient reported good medication adherence, improved energy, and resolution of excessive thirst. Home blood glucose readings trending lower.

source.snippet: Pt returns for f/u of T2D. A1c 8.4% on metformin 500 b.i.d. Tolerating well, no GI sx.

events.title: Increased metformin to 1000 mg b.i.d.
events.summary: Metformin dose increased from 500 mg to 1000 mg twice daily due to A1c remaining above goal. Patient was counseled on a gradual 5-day titration to minimize stomach side effects.

source.snippet: Δ metformin → 1000 mg PO b.i.d. F/u A1c in 3 months.

events.title: HbA1c — 7.2 %
events.summary: Hemoglobin A1c (a 3-month average blood sugar measure) came back at 7.2%, which is above the normal range of 4.0–5.6%. This is an improvement from a prior result, though still slightly above the typical diabetes management goal of under 7.0%.

events.title: PCP follow-up — diabetes management
events.summary: Routine 3-month diabetes follow-up with Dr. Levy. Type 2 diabetes (T2D) reported as well controlled. Patient noted weight loss of 9 lbs since January and sustained lifestyle changes including diet and walking.

source.snippet: Sarah returns for routine 3-month diabetes follow-up. Her August A1c (drawn 08/21/2023) was 7.2%, the best reading since her diagnosis in January. She reports doing well overall.

events.title: Referral to ophthalmology — diabetic eye exam
events.summary: Annual diabetic eye exam referral placed by Dr. Levy as part of routine diabetes monitoring.

source.snippet: Annual diabetic eye exam referral placed (separate document).

events.title: HbA1c — 6.9 %
events.summary: Hemoglobin A1c (a 3-month blood sugar average) came back at 6.9%, flagged high compared to the general reference range (4.0–5.6%) but noted to be at the treatment target for people with diabetes (below 7.0%). This is the first result to reach that diabetes management goal.

source.snippet: Hemoglobin A1c: 6.9 % (H). Reference range 4.0-5.6 %. Note: at target for diabetic patients (<7.0).

events.title: LDL Cholesterol — 145 mg/dL
events.summary: Fasting lipid panel showed LDL (bad) cholesterol elevated at 145 mg/dL against an optimal target of under 100 mg/dL. Total cholesterol and non-HDL cholesterol were also flagged high; HDL and triglycerides were within normal limits.

source.snippet: LDL Cholesterol: 145 mg/dL (H). Reference: <100 mg/dL optimal.

events.title: PCP annual physical — routine
events.summary: Routine annual physical with Dr. Levy. No new complaints. Diabetes well-controlled; exam including diabetic foot exam unremarkable.

events.title: Referral to ophthalmology — diabetic eye exam
events.summary: Annual diabetic eye exam referral pending as part of routine diabetes care.

source.snippet: Annual diabetic eye exam due — referral pending.
